Dialogue_Text:
This ring was made using dried fire rowan, and enchanted with powerful magic. Tales say it was created by a powerful yet quite mad druid, a fire giant that tried to claim part of the bog for himself.

STATISTICS:

Equipped abilities:
– Armor Class: +2
– Saving Throws: +2

Charge abilities:
– Fire Seed once per day
  Effect: Creates 4 fire seeds that will appear in the caster's inventory. The seeds will remain in existence for 3 turns after the spell is cast. If they are thrown at an enemy, a fireball will ensue, causing 2d8 points of damage to all within a 7-ft. radius unless they make a Saving Throw vs. Spell for half damage.
